title: Prescriptions Class Schedule for Store Moves and Transfers
content:
Kestrel Prescriptions move between Kestrel stores, arrive from pharmacies outside Kestrel and leave for them on the per-class terms below.

## Moves between Kestrel stores and transfers in

| Handling class | Move to another Kestrel store allowed | Move only while never dispensed | Transfer in from outside Kestrel allowed |
|---|---|---|---|
| Non-Controlled Acute Prescription | Yes | No | Yes |
| Non-Controlled Maintenance Prescription | Yes | No | Yes |
| Schedule V Controlled Prescription | Yes | No | Yes |
| Schedule III-IV Controlled Prescription | Yes | No | Yes |
| Schedule II Controlled Prescription | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Specialty Limited-Distribution Prescription | Yes | No | Yes |

## Transfers out to a pharmacy outside Kestrel

| Handling class | Transfer out allowed | Only if never transferred before | Only while never dispensed | Only if received as an electronic prescription |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Non-Controlled Acute Prescription | Yes | No | No | No |
| Non-Controlled Maintenance Prescription | Yes | No | No | No |
| Schedule V Controlled Prescription | Yes | Yes | No | No |
| Schedule III-IV Controlled Prescription | Yes | Yes | No | No |
| Schedule II Controlled Prescription | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Specialty Limited-Distribution Prescription | Yes | No | No | No |

A Yes in a column that begins "only" makes that column a condition of the move or transfer for the class; a No means the class carries no such condition.

## Readings (hypothetical records)

- A Schedule III-IV Controlled Prescription that arrived at Kestrel by transfer from another pharmacy has been transferred before, so it does not meet its class's "only if never transferred before" condition for a transfer out.
- A Schedule II Controlled Prescription that has had its original fill dispensed can no longer move to another Kestrel store, because its class allows a move only while the prescription has never been dispensed.
- A Non-Controlled Maintenance Prescription carries none of the "only" conditions.
